name: super-join
description: super-join is a wasm library for turning your graphql queries into SQL queries which solves the n+1 problem

scripts.build:wasm: cargo component build -p super-join-component --target wasm32-wasip1 && npx jco transpile target/wasm32-wasip1/debug/super_join.wasm -o pkg --name super_join && npx jco types wit/wit.wit -o src-js/types/generated/wit
scripts.build:package: npm run build:wasm && npm run build && npm run stage
scripts.docs:rust: cargo doc --no-deps -p super-join-core -p super-join-component && rm -rf docs/super-join/rust-api && cp -r target/doc docs/super-join/rust-api
scripts.docs: npm run docs:ts && npm run docs:rust

author: John Johnson
